rows.label: Cranked front / current primaries

bracing.scope: Preserve the original F05-F06 weak-axis pinned-column Euler capacity on all eight route-interpolated hats. Fixed 50 x 32 mm outer section, wall rounded up by 0.5 mm. Add 100 mm transfer length at each end. Local/distortional instability, forming, connectors and actual axial loads remain open. This is a relative bracing allowance, not substantiation of the installed hats.

rows.frame_mass_convention: Baseline 3.8 g locally stable frame gauges are held fixed. Their linear stresses scale with load; these totals are not re-sized all-airframe masses.
